references.name: AWA equalizer preset guide
references.note: Used for genre and listening-purpose profile descriptions; gain values here are newly authored.

presets.name: Flat
presets.description: No tonal change.

presets.name: Gentle Smile
presets.description: Subtle bass and treble lift.

presets.name: Gentle Warmth
presets.description: A mild, relaxed low-frequency tilt.

presets.name: Gentle Clarity
presets.description: A mild presence and air lift.

presets.name: Bass Booster
presets.description: Broad bass emphasis without a sharp resonance.

presets.name: Bass Reducer
presets.description: Broad bass attenuation.

presets.name: Sub Bass Boost
presets.description: Adds weight below about 100 Hz.

presets.name: Sub Bass Cut
presets.description: Controls rumble and excessive sub bass.

presets.name: Warm
presets.description: Adds body in the bass and low mids.

presets.name: Low-Mid Cleanup
presets.description: Reduces muddiness around 250–500 Hz.

presets.name: Vocal Booster
presets.description: Brings vocals and speech forward.

presets.name: Vocal Reducer
presets.description: Recesses the center vocal range.

presets.name: Presence
presets.description: Adds articulation in the upper mids.

presets.name: Treble Booster
presets.description: Broad high-frequency emphasis.

presets.name: Treble Reducer
presets.description: Broad high-frequency attenuation.

presets.name: Air
presets.description: Opens the top octave while preserving presence.

presets.name: De-Esser Curve
presets.description: Softens common sibilance frequencies.

presets.name: Loudness
presets.description: Strong smile curve for low-level listening.

presets.name: Night Listening
presets.description: Restrains deep bass and sharp highs.

presets.name: Small Speakers
presets.description: Reduces unusable sub bass and adds intelligibility.

presets.name: Headphones
presets.description: A restrained contour for general headphone listening.
